name: the marking returns to keeping: celebration followed by renewed defence
what_it_changes: The model runs from building to marking (A07) and from building to keeping (A03), but not from marking back to keeping. In these rooms it does: a celebration or completion post draws renewed defence calls, repair and night cover in its own thread.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/link_P05_T3-009.txt, state one shared change to P05. 'A completion celebration receives a direct protection appeal, making celebration a point for renewing upkeep rather than simply ending work' (httyd); 'Celebration threads reopen into vigilance and night coverage rather than terminating maintenance' (newzealand).
